Author: LENA-integration-agent
Message:
fix(checkout): accept split tenders with the same method and amount

Each payment row's idempotency key was ${key}#pay:${method}:${amount}, so a
750 bill paid as cash 375 + cash 375 (or card + card) produced two identical
keys, violated payments_tenant_idem_uq (23505) and POST /api/v1/checkout
answered 500 'Internal server error'; the whole sale rolled back.
The key now includes the tender's position: ${key}#pay:${i}:${method}:${amount}.
Replay detection is unaffected (it is decided on the sale header key, under
the shift lock); only newly written payment rows use the new format.

Test (HTTP, PGlite, nile_app): apps/api/test/split-tender.test.ts
- cash 375+375 -> 201, two cash payments of 375 with distinct ids; replay -> 200
  replayed, same two payments; card 375+375 -> 201; closure expected 10750.
Old checkout.ts: 3/3 fail (500, 500, closure 10000). New: 3/3 pass.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Mohamed
Message:
feat: first end-to-end operational path — login → permissions → tenant → saved sale

Review first (docs/reviews/2026-10-14-engines-db-auth-review.md), every
defect reproduced on real PostgreSQL before fixing:
- F1 CRITICAL cross-tenant FK hole (FK checks bypass RLS) → composite
  (tenant_id, parent_id) foreign keys on every child table
- F2 int4 money overflow at 21.4M EGP → bigint
- F3 hand-written migration (vs ADR-0004) → Drizzle Kit generated + custom
  hardening migration (runtime role nile_app, FORCE RLS, grants)
- F4 client-supplied prices → server-side catalog pricing, strict contracts
- F5 engines not wired to persistence → sale + catalog services
- F6/F7 auth-compatible tenancy (Better Auth organization = tenant) and
  app refuses to start if its DB role can bypass RLS

Auth & permissions: Better Auth 1.7.7 + Organization plugin (ADR-0005),
roles via Better Auth access control (new ADR-0007), sign-up disabled,
demo tenant + 14 role accounts provisioned on boot.

API: NestJS 12 + Fastify 5 (ADR-0001), auth.handler mounted per ADR-0005 §8,
REST + OpenAPI from Zod contracts (ADR-0006).

Tests: 91/91 — all ADR-0005 §9 invariants with exact SQLSTATEs, guard test
for future tables, and a 23-case HTTP e2e (login → sale → idempotent retry →
stock guard → 403s → cross-company 404/422 → tenant-spoofing → logout →
restart persistence). E2E suite mutation-checked (3 planted bugs caught).
